campaign.title: Direction Through Real Weeks
campaign.strategy_summary: A 20-post Instagram sequence that moves from specific rigid-habit friction to source-backed adaptive mechanisms and transparent early-product invitations, while preserving three matched, attributable comparisons and distinct funnel reporting.

notes: All posts remain subject to human review.
Experiment conclusions require the CMO-defined minimum evidence and verified instrumentation.
